blocks.md: **Naive pattern search = O(n·m) rescan. KMP pays O(m) preprocessing so the TEXT POINTER NEVER MOVES BACKWARD.**

The engine is the **failure table lps[i]** = length of longest proper prefix of pattern that is also suffix ending at i. Mismatch after matching k chars? Fall back to lps[k−1], not to start — already-matched context survives partially.

blocks.label: Multiply Strings (LC43) core
blocks.py:
res = [0] * (len(n1) + len(n2))
for i in range(len(n1)-1, -1, -1):
    for j in range(len(n2)-1, -1, -1):
        mul = int(n1[i]) * int(n2[j])
        p = i + j + 1
        total = mul + res[p]
        res[p] = total % 10
        res[p-1] += total // 10     # carry leftward
